title: Record the frames around the flag-0 tail add
body:
## Summary
- At the end of the channel prefix, `X0` holds `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]` and `Y34` holds its rank-8 frame. The tail never writes `X0`.
- Event 5758 promotes `Y34` onto that full frame. Event 5759 adds `-1/2` times `X0` there, and event 5807 restores the rank-8 frame. All 48 tail adds into `Y34` sit between those transports.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The transport is not compiled as a native recipe here.

## Test plan
